messages:
harper: spotted a small but reproducible retry spike for aegis-quant-v5 after runtime 4.3.2 unpin. seen mostly in eu-west and us-east, ap-south looks fine. anyone on call?

deploybot: Deploybot: anomaly detected: increased retry_rate=1.8% for model=aegis-quant-v5 regions=[eu-west,us-east] at 07:42 UTC. No active pin. (bot)

sre_zoe: digging through traces now. pattern: KV lookup N+1 misses on interleaved requests -> retries. sample log: `WARN kv_lookup: shard=12 seq=3072 miss_count=2`

runtime_lead: runtime 4.3.2 introduced a background compaction that can change shard alignment timing. suspect compaction + model shard layout -> transient miss window.

harper: can we do a staggered soft-pin to runtime 4.2.9 in eu-west and us-east for 90m, keep ap-south untouched, and retain a 5% canary on 4.3.2 globally? avoids global rollback while giving runtime team time to patch.

release_czar: agree with staggered approach. rollback criteria: if retry_rate >0.7% sustained 10m in pinned region -> escalate to full pin; if end-to-end latency regresses >12% after pin, rollback pin and revert to 4.3.2 while we hotfix. owners: runtime + infra-sre.

sdk_ops: FYI SDK 6.1 has a retry-coalescing change that reduces duplicate in-flight token fetches; that should mitigate some symptoms, but we shouldn't rely on SDK rollouts mid-incident.

harper: ok deploybot command: `/deploybot pin-runtime --model aegis-quant-v5 --runtime 4.2.9 --regions eu-west,us-east --duration 90m --canary 5%`

deploybot: executing: applying pins and preserving 5% canary to 4.3.2 across all regions. will report when complete.

deploybot: Pin operation successful at 6913579048 :white_check_mark: pinned runtime=4.2.9 regions=[eu-west,us-east] duration=90m canary=5%

sre_zoe: running regression + tailing dashboards. initial numbers: retry_rate dropped to 0.35% in eu-west, 0.4% in us-east within 3m.

runtime_lead: I'll open a patch branch to add a compaction-safe alignment guard and test under churn. ETA for patch PR: ~3h. if that lands quickly we can lift pin early and roll forward a patched 4.3.3.

harper: release note snippet I can post: "Applied temporary staggered runtime pin to 4.2.9 for aegis-quant-v5 in eu-west & us-east to mitigate retry spike observed after 4.3.2 unpin. 90m soft-pin; 5% canary to 4.3.2 retained. Owners: runtime, infra-sre."

release_czar: monitoring. opsbot please post a summary to #incidents if escalation triggers or if we lift early.

opsbot: A follow-up automated summary will be posted at pin-lift or at 6913579948 if not lifted early. (bot)

sre_zoe: will post 10m perf deltas and a short repro recipe in the ticket. thanks everyone.
